text:
maria_marketing: Need a compact one-pager / playbook for the webinar follow-up aimed at security/compliance + infra leads. Must be sales-ready and web-downloadable.
sam_sales: Can we include a 15s and 30s pitch, two email snippets (short and long), and explicit routing tags? AEs want a CSV-friendly SFDC tag.
devon_product: I'll put together the first draft structure: 1) TL;DR (2 lines) 2) Deploy modes (quick pros/cons) 3) SLA summary + escalation path 4) Security controls (KMS, audit, network) 5) Benchmark snapshot 6) AE-ready snippets & objection responses 7) Download CTA + routing.
tara_field: Add an "AE playbook" box with: who to call, what logs to ask for, and a one-paragraph technical outline they can paste in an email.
oliver_growth: We'll need UTMs and an A/B headline experiment. Propose: A = "Control & Compliance for Inference", B = "Predictable SLAs, Lower Costs". Also want a lead_score tag: enterprise_secure_70 for intent scoring.
kai_eng: For benchmark numbers please mark as provisional. My run shows slightly better P95 on our tuning build: P95 = 78ms; throughput = 140 reqs/s on 8xA100-like nodes; token cost = ~0.55x vs baseline. Failover fallback to warm model in ~180ms. Add small note about measurement config.
maria_marketing: Good — devon owns draft, sam finalizes sales copy, oliver sets tracking, tara verifies AE copy, kai verifies benchmark text. Deadline: Thursday 12:00 PT for content in drive.
devon_product: Draft micro-copy (first pass):

"Redwood Secure Deploy — enterprise inference you can audit, control, and operate predictably. One API across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments with configurable SLAs and customer-controlled keys."

Deploy modes (one-liners):
- Hosted: Fast onboarding, managed models, best for quick POC and dev teams.
- Dedicated: Reserved GPU pools, predictable throughput, SLA options for production apps.
- Private: VPC or on-prem, KMS/HSM integration, audit logs and air-gap support.

SLA callout: Optional enterprise SLA (99.95% with reserved capacity), P95 latency targets by model tier, 4-hour incident response with 24x7 escalation for enterprise customers.

Security callout: Customer-managed KMS, VPC peering / private link, comprehensive audit logs (immutable), role-based access controls, SOC2-ready controls.

Benchmark snapshot (provisional): P95 78ms; Throughput 140 reqs/s on 8x GPU config; Token unit cost ~0.55x vs naive serving. Measurement: 1B token workload, mixed short/med requests.

AE snippets (paste-ready):
- 15s pitch: "We provide enterprise-grade inference with deploy options that keep keys, logs, and control inside your perimeter while meeting predictable latency targets."
- 30s pitch: "Redwood lets platform and security teams run the same inference API across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. That means your teams can move to private or reserved capacity without reworking code, keep KMS/HSM-managed keys, capture immutable audit logs, and hit P95 latency SLAs with our runtime optimizations."

Email templates (select A or B):
- Short subject: "Secure inference + enterprise SLAs — one-pager"
- Short body: "Hi <Name>, attaching a brief that outlines deploy options, SLA guarantees, and our security controls. Can we schedule 20m to see how this fits your compliance needs?"
- Long body: "Hi <Name>, following up from the webinar — attached is a concise playbook describing how Redwood supports secure inference at scale. It covers Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployment modes, our SLA options, key management integrations (KMS/HSM), and benchmark highlights for latency and cost. If youd like, I can set up a technical review with our platform engineer. Best, <AE>"

Objection handling (copyable):
- Data residency: "We support VPC, on-prem, and region-specific deployments; keys remain under customer control via KMS/HSM."
- SLA credibility: "Reserved capacity with SLAs, documented runbooks, and 24x7 escalation available as part of enterprise agreements."
- Auditability: "Immutable audit logs + exportable traces for compliance reviews and SOC2 evidence."

Routing / tracking (ops-ready):
- Asset download -> tag: enterprise-secure-deploy
- utm_campaign=secure_deploy_webinar; utm_content=onepager_v1
- SFDC: Lead.OwnerQueue = AE_Enterprise_Security; Lead.Priority = High; CustomField: Lead_Source_Playbook = secure-deploy-webinar
- Auto email follow-up template: mk_follow_secure_v2 (send after download)
- Lead scoring: if download && company_size > 500 && requested_trial -> add enterprise_secure_70

maria_marketing: Can you also add two short social blurbs for posting? Keep them CTA-forward.
devon_product: Social blurbs:
- LinkedIn (short): "Enterprise inference that meets your SLAs and compliance needs. Download the Secure Deploy playbook. [link] #infosec #MLOps"
- Twitter/X: "Secure deploys, predictable SLAs, lower unit cost. Get the quick playbook -> [link]"
sam_sales: AEs want a tiny tech checklist for discovery calls (one-liner bullets). Put into the AE playbook box.
tara_field: AE checklist (discovery):
- What region(s) do you need?
- Do you require KMS/HSM or key segregation?
- Expected p95 latency requirement?
- Required compliance standards (SOC2, ISO, FedRAMP, etc.)
- Data residency / on-prem requirement?
- Estimated RPS and peak concurrency

kai_eng: Add an explicit benchmarking note: "Numbers are representative of internal pre-release tuning runs on our runtime. Customers should measure with their workload; ask for a dedicated trial for precise sizing."
maria_marketing: Nice. Ops asks: name the downloadable asset file and gating fields.
oliver_growth: File name: secure-deploy-playbook-v1.pdf. Gating fields: company, work_email, role, use_case, region, estimated_RPS. Add hidden form field: source=secure-deploy-webinar.
maria_marketing: Final checklist (copyable):
```
- devon_product: deliver v1 one-pager to drive (Wed EOD)
- kai_eng: verify benchmark line and add measurement note (Thu AM)
- sam_sales: finalize AE snippets + email templates (Thu noon)
- oliver_growth: set UTMs, form fields, and SFDC routing (Thu afternoon)
- tara_field: confirm AE playbook and objections (Thu afternoon)
- marketing_ops: create gated download + attach mk_follow_secure_v2 (Thu EOD)
```

launch-bot: Webinar reminder set for 2026-04-09 11:00 PT / 2026-04-09 18:00 UTC.

maria_marketing: Thanks team. We'll reconvene Thu 10:30 PT to finalize. :rocket:
